name: dsir-global-snapshot-pilot
description: Look up and compare six dated worldwide health series from WHO GHO, UN SDG and WHO GHE.

interface.longDescription: Find country and area estimates, bounds, years and CSV downloads in a fixed DSIR snapshot of six series from WHO GHO, the UN SDG database and WHO Global Health Estimates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Compare the latest tuberculosis incidence estimates for Brazil and Viet Nam. Include each estimate, year, unit, uncertainty bounds and country CSV.
